Container.Name: HomeIPTV
Container.Overview: Personal guide and restreamer for playlists and HDHomeRun tuners you are allowed to watch. Pull ghcr.io/davidmcferrin-spec/home-iptv:latest. A private package needs a read:packages token, or the package must be public. Use docker-compose.yml so MediaMTX and the worker run with this app. Do not publish the stack to the internet.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Guide and API. The container listens on 8080.

Config.Name: WebRTC TCP
Config.Description: WHEP signaling. Publish this on the MediaMTX container when using the compose stack.

Config.Name: HDHomeRun discovery
Config.Description: UDP discovery. Use host networking or macvlan if broadcast discovery must work.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id for config and data files

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id for config and data files

Config.Name: Idle timeout
Config.Description: Optional override. Settings in the guide is the normal place to change this.

Config.Name: MediaMTX API
Config.Description: Control API of the MediaMTX container

Config.Name: MediaMTX RTSP
Config.Description: RTSP publish target inside the stack
